name: multiple_choice: A confidence interval using de Moivre's equation is valid…

request.questionText: A confidence interval using de Moivre's equation is valid if which of the following conditions is true?

choices.label: A
choices.text: We are calculating a confidence interval for a population proportion based on a sample proportion.

choices.label: B
choices.text: We are calculating a confidence interval for a coefficient in a regression model based on a sample model estimate.

choices.label: C
choices.text: We are calculating a confidence interval for a population mean based on a sample mean.

choices.label: D
choices.text: We are calculating a confidence interval for the population difference in group proportions based on the difference in proportions from a sample.
